stories.story_fr: Airo AI Builder, l'expérience IA native développée en interne, a atteint un rythme de réservations annualisé de plusieurs millions de dollars en quelques semaines après son lancement en beta, avec une forte adoption et monétisation précoces.
stories.story_en: Airo AI Builder, GoDaddy's internally-built AI-native experience, reached a multi-million dollar annualized bookings run rate within weeks of its beta launch, with strong early adoption and monetization.
stories.signal: GoDaddy continued to expand its internally-built AI-native experiences, with Airo AI Builder delivering strong early adoption and monetization and achieving a multi-million dollar annualized bookings run rate within just weeks of its beta launch.

stories.story_fr: GoDaddy a lancé son Agent Name Service (ANS), un protocole d'identité pour les agents IA bâti sur l'infrastructure DNS et proposé comme standard ouvert, étendant son leadership dans le domaine de la confiance en ligne à l'internet agentique.
stories.story_en: GoDaddy launched its Agent Name Service (ANS), an identity protocol for AI agents built on DNS infrastructure and proposed as an open standard, extending its online trust leadership into the agentic internet.
stories.signal: Launched GoDaddy's Agent Name Service (ANS), an identity protocol for AI agents built on DNS infrastructure and proposed as an open standard. ANS extends our leadership in online trust and safety into the agentic internet, allowing secure discovery and validation of agents across the open web.

stories.story_fr: GoDaddy a fait évoluer son expérience Airo d'une plateforme d'IA générative vers une plateforme d'IA agentique, lançant cinq nouveaux agents Airo pour traiter les besoins clés des clients, désormais disponibles sur Airo.ai.
stories.story_en: GoDaddy evolved its Airo experience from a generative AI platform to an agentic AI platform, launching five new Airo agents to handle core customer needs, now live at Airo.ai.
stories.signal: Evolved the Airo experience from a Generative AI platform to an Agentic AI platform, launching five new Airo agents to intuitively handle core customer needs. These agentic capabilities are now live at Airo.ai, GoDaddy's Airo platform extension for rapid testing, innovation and agent deployment.
